newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mohandes net 95/96 profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mohandes net 95/96 profits rise.

text.p: Mohandes Insurance will pay a two pound dividend per share for the 1995/96 financial year and has also increased net profits available for distribution to 7.3 million pounds from 6.6 million in the previous year, a company statement on Sunday showed.
The dividend is equivalent to 20 percent of the nominal value of the 2.2 million shares, the company said. It did not give comparative 1994/95 dividend figures.
Mohandes Insurance shares are held by a small group of investors and are rarely traded on the Egyptian stock exchange. They were last traded at 24.00 pounds.
